text: Octopuses have three hearts.
Sharks are older than trees.
Bananas are berries. Strawberries aren't.
A day on Venus is longer than its year.
Wombat poop is cube-shaped.
Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth.
The Eiffel Tower grows ~15 cm taller in summer heat.
Nintendo was founded in 1889, making playing cards.
Honey can stay edible for thousands of years.
A teaspoon of neutron star weighs about a billion tons.
In a room of 23 people, a shared birthday is more likely than not.
Amazon started in a garage in Bellevue, WA, in 1994.
The Space Needle was built for the 1962 World's Fair.
Starbucks was founded in Seattle in 1971.
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
Venus spins backwards compared to most planets.
Hummingbirds can fly backwards.
Saturn would float in water.
Over a million Earths could fit inside the Sun.
Footprints on the Moon could last millions of years.
Mantis shrimp can punch through aquarium glass.
Axolotls can regrow limbs, jaws, and parts of the brain.
Tardigrades have survived the vacuum of space.
Sea otters hold hands while sleeping so they don't drift apart.
Cows have best friends and get stressed when separated.
Your body makes about 25 million new cells every second.
Try it: you can't hum while holding your nose shut.
Harvard was founded before calculus was invented.
Mammoths still walked the Earth while the pyramids were built.
Einstein turned down the presidency of Israel in 1952.
The first computer bug was a real moth, found in 1947.
Zero can't be written in Roman numerals.
A shuffled deck is almost certainly a first in history.
Peanuts are one of the ingredients in dynamite.
Apples float because they are 25% air.
Potatoes were the first food grown in space.
The dot over the letters i and j is called a tittle.
The Pringles can inventor is buried in one.

Golf is the only sport ever played on the Moon.
